subject: Sheep
observations: Current source re-inspected individually at full image resolution; hash is unchanged from the approved latest sheep.
Two clear black eyes, coherent nose/mouth, two ears, four separately visible legs with hooves and a woolly tail form a complete recognizable sheep.

Cream wool, tan face/legs, brown hooves, coral inner ears, red scarf, golden-yellow patch, cyan and purple flowers, orange flower centers and green foliage provide roughly ten meaningful color families. Ground/leaf greens count together; background and facial ink are excluded.
Paired inner ears, four tan legs, four brown hooves, two orange flower centers and repeated leaves support number/color matching. Connected petals are not counted as separate enclosed regions.
Large scarf, contrasting patch and substantial flowers materially improve engagement over the original sheep while retaining broad accessible shapes.
processed_gate_checks: Source PASS does not supersede the previously reported diagnostic defects: stray tiny numbered regions and crowded labels require processor review.
Verify cream/background separation and usable ear, scarf-patch and small-flower regions; confirm processed-output provenance before assigning approval to this source.
method: Individual current image visually inspected with view_image; decisions consider substantial contrasting colors, meaningful repeated regions, anatomy and cleanliness against user-approved 35/37 benchmarks.
scope: Source-image visual gate for this exact hash only. PASS permits processor evaluation; it does not approve extracted regions, final number placement, gameplay assets or video.
